Model components

Source: R/model.R
sbml_components.Rd

Each accessor returns one data frame of an sbml_model, one row per element. Scalar attributes are columns, named in snake_case after the SBML attribute (initialAmount is initial_amount); optional attributes that are absent are NA. Math is a list column. Every table also has metaid, sbo_term, and notes and annotation as XML text.

Usage

sbml_compartments(m)

sbml_species(m)

sbml_parameters(m)

sbml_reactions(m)

sbml_rules(m)

sbml_events(m)

sbml_functions(m)

sbml_initial_assignments(m)

sbml_constraints(m)

sbml_unit_definitions(m)

Arguments

m

An sbml_model.

Value

A data frame.

Details

sbml_reactions() holds the species references (reactants, products, modifiers) as data frames and kinetic_law as a list with math and local_parameters. sbml_events() holds trigger, priority, delay and assignments. sbml_rules() has a type column: "assignment", "rate" or "algebraic". sbml_functions() adds fun, each lambda as an R function; see sbml_math() for how math is represented.

Examples

m <- sbml_read(system.file("extdata", "decay.xml", package = "zusbml"))
sbml_species(m)
#>   id name compartment initial_amount initial_concentration substance_units
#> 1 S1 <NA>           C              1                    NA            <NA>
#> 2 S2 <NA>           C              0                    NA            <NA>
#>   has_only_substance_units boundary_condition constant conversion_factor metaid
#> 1                    FALSE              FALSE    FALSE              <NA>   <NA>
#> 2                    FALSE              FALSE    FALSE              <NA>   <NA>
#>   sbo_term notes annotation
#> 1     <NA>  <NA>       <NA>
#> 2     <NA>  <NA>       <NA>
sbml_reactions(m)$reactants[[1]]
#>     id name species stoichiometry constant metaid sbo_term notes annotation
#> 1 <NA> <NA>      S1             1     TRUE   <NA>     <NA>  <NA>       <NA>
